svg.text: Home lab built to practise a full Configuration Manager to Microsoft Intune migration
Home router or laptop connection sharing
Intel i5-8500, 6 cores, 32 GB RAM, dual boot with Windows
10.10.10.0/24, isolated from home and work networks
DC01 and DC02, forwarding to pfSense
Weekly Proxmox jobs to the external drive
Microsoft 365 tenant: Entra ID and Intune
vmbr1 isolated lab switch, no physical port | 10.10.10.0/24
Windows Server VMs and one Linux container
Linked clones of a sysprepped Windows 11 template, addresses from DC01 DHCP
All traffic leaves the lab through pfSense
Password hash sync, password writeback, SSPR
Hybrid join, Kerberos server object (cloud trust)
Group Policy analytics to Settings catalog
Windows Hello for Business, cloud Kerberos
Autopilot profile and Enrollment Status Page
Syncs the Lab OU to Entra ID, hash sync,
workloads moved one slider at a time
Lab environment, not production. Built and documented by Teboho Motholo.
